preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 100) representing the number of independent games.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**9 for line in stdin if line.strip().isdigit() and not line.startswith('?') and not line.startswith('!'))
preconditions.description: Each hidden X in the T games satisfies 1 ≤ X ≤ 10^9 (implicitly, since the interactor enforces this).
The interactor is non-adaptive: X is fixed before all queries in a game.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(Q) <= 10**18 for Q in (line.split()[1] for line in stdin if line.startswith('?')))
preconditions.description: Each query Q must satisfy 1 ≤ Q ≤ 10^18.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().startswith('? ') or line.strip().startswith('! ') for line in stdin if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Output lines are either queries ('? Q') or answers ('! ans').

preconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdin if line.strip().startswith('?')]) <= 22 * T
preconditions.description: No more than 22 queries are made per game (total ≤ 22*T).

postconditions.expression: all((lambda: (ans := int(stdout_line.split()[1]), d := len([1] + [i for i in range(2, int(X)+1) if X % i == 0]), abs(ans - d) <= 7 or (1/2 <= ans/d <= 2)))() for X, stdout_line in zip([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin if line.strip().isdigit() and not line.startswith('?') and not line.startswith('!')], [line for line in stdout if line.strip().startswith('!')]))
postconditions.description: For each hidden X, the answer ans must satisfy |ans - d| ≤ 7 or 1/2 ≤ ans/d ≤ 2, where d is the true number of divisors of X.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().startswith('! ') for line in stdout if line.strip() and not any(line.strip().startswith('?') for _ in range(22)))
postconditions.description: Each game must end with exactly one answer ('! ans') after at most 22 queries.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda: (queries := [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin if line.startswith('?')], gcds := [int(input()) for _ in queries], len(queries) == len(gcds)))() for _ in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each game, every query Q must receive exactly one gcd(X, Q) response before the answer is submitted.
